orders.thesis: Full exit. QQQ is the weakest of the four watchlist names and deteriorating fastest: 5d -6.79% as of 2026-06-10 versus -3.82% (SPY), -8.16% (GLD, already broken) and +2.67% (XLF, still positive). GLD's 20d move worsened to -13.48%, which reads as broad risk-off rather than a rotation into safety, so I am trimming the weakest long ahead of its stated stop (693.69 close still above the 670.00 stop, but the rate of deterioration is the signal, not just the level).
